'''Tharangambadi power station (PPN Power)''' is a cancelled power station in Pillaiperumalnallur and Manickapangu, Tarangambadi and Sirkali, Nagapattinum, Tamil Nadu, India.

==Background==

PPN Power owns and operates a 330 MW gas- and naphtha-fired, combined cycle power plant at villages Pillaiperumalnallur and Manickapangu. The plant has been in operation since April 2001.<ref>[http://www.ppnpower.com/ "Welcome to PPN Power,"] PPN Power website, accessed April 2015</ref> 

In December 2014 PPN Power received a terms of reference toward conducting an EIA for adding two coal-burning units of 160 MW each at the power station.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1CZJ1kq Terms of reference,] India MoEF, Dec 12, 2014</ref>

As of May 2017 the company's expansion plans only describe new gas-fired generation capacity. Plans to build coal-fired generating units appear to be abandoned.<Ref>[http://www.ppnpower.com/Expansion.html#Expansion "Expansion,"] PPN Power, accessed June 2017</ref>
